rules.progression: Historical original rank costs define the budget. Legacy effects are stepped to the purchased major stage end-rank. Ordinary stat minors do not advance legacy ranks.
rules.cost_split: Per old-rank segment: <=15 SP: one minor; 16..37 SP: two minors; >=38 SP: three minors. Minors jointly get max(count, round(22% of segment old cost)), remainder to major; integer prices sum exactly.
rules.stage_splitting: Cut each original skill at every 10 ranks, every original SkillTreeCatalog milestone, and final max rank. Preserve 5/15/25/35 special thresholds.

graph_layout.placement: Place each original skill along its own ray within its sector. Minor nodes and then major nodes form successive outward stages; stage nodes are ~70 world units apart, starting radius 240. Icons ~42 world units, pan/zoom required. The group hub connects all first minor nodes for that sector.
graph_layout.bridge_rule: Visual and traversable minor-to-minor bridges connect adjacent skill rays at segment indexes 1 and 3 when both rays have them. A bridge may grant access to a stat minor but never bypasses a major's own preceding-stage prerequisite.
graph_layout.major_unlock: All minors of own stage purchased and preceding major of same original skill purchased; group hub is an always-unlocked visual entry.
graph_layout.minor_unlock: Adjacent to the free group hub, an owned node in the same ray, or an owned adjacent-ray minor via a bridge.
graph_layout.ui: Distinct skill-map background (not Profile plum wallpaper); clipped zoom/pan graph, right-side details, name/bonus/costs/remaining SP, minimize/fit control; actual glyph and texture sampling require Minecraft review.

rules.migration: At world load, map each legacy skill rank to the largest fully completed new stage. Mark all minors and the major for each completed stage. Refund only the cost of an incomplete tail (< next stage threshold) to that class's unspent SP. Each fully completed stage costs exactly its original rank-cost sum, so total earned SP is conserved. Migration idempotent/version-tagged; do not erase class XP, BD, contracts, puppets or swarm data.
rules.legacy_power_limit: The complete original skill reaches exactly its former max rank and old milestone effects (as currently specified in source docs). Extra vanilla attributes are additional small proposed bonuses and require balance review; neither original formulas nor current non-SP growth are rewritten.
